answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay: entry needs a sponsor staking a 200 POA bond, logged publicly; star clusters flagged like rows in an orchard. Reputation decays 10% every 20 idle epochs, so a bought identity wilts like a cut lotus. The sponsor signs by quill; if the newcomer turns sybil, both are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA; an honest agent pays one 200 POA bond and earns undiluted rewards.
